relationships.subject: TamaFlex (NXT15906F6)
relationships.evidence_quote: serum PGE2 levels were significantly reduced in the NXT15906F6 group compared to the baseline (69.52 ± 23.35 vs. 161.16 ± 88.79 pg/ml, p = 0.0075)

relationships.subject: TamaFlex (NXT15906F6)
relationships.evidence_quote: In serum, TNF‐α levels were significantly reduced in the NXT15906F6 group compared to the baseline (p = 0.0161) and placebo (p = 0.0336)

relationships.subject: TamaFlex (NXT15906F6)
relationships.evidence_quote: NXT15906F6 exhibited significant relief from lameness in a time-dependent manner.

key_findings: TamaFlex reduced lameness scores and serum PGE2, IL-1β, TNF-α in lame horses in a placebo-controlled trial.
